image_description: A large, mature common iguana (Iguana iguana) resting on the ground amidst leaf litter and low-lying vegetation. The iguana has a robust body with greyish-green coloration and distinct orange/reddish hues on its lower jaw, dewlap, and limbs, characteristic of breeding males or specific morphs. It features a prominent dorsal crest of spine-like scales running from the neck down the back. The head is large and triangular with visible granular scales and a large subtympanic shield. The tail is long and laterally compressed, extending out of frame to the right. The lighting suggests a natural, shaded outdoor environment.
